question: If at same rate of interest, in 2 years, the simple interest is ₹42 and compound interest is ₹45 , then what is the principal (in ₹)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = ₹45 − ₹42 = ₹3.

SI for 1 year = ₹42 ÷ 2 = ₹21.

Rate % = (Difference ÷ SI for 1 year) × 100 = (3 ÷ 21) × 100 = 100/7%.

Principal = (SI for 1 year × 100) ÷ Rate = (21 × 100) ÷ (100/7) = 21 × 7 = ₹147.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹147.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Simple Interest for 2 years = ₹42

Compound Interest for 2 years = ₹45

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 Principal (P)

 

 

 
 Year 1 SI
 ₹21

 
 Year 2 SI
 ₹21

 

 
 
 + ₹3

**Formula Used:**

SI for 1 year = Total SI ÷ Time

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = CI − SI

Rate (R) = (Difference ÷ SI for 1st year) × 100

Principal (P) = (SI × 100) ÷ (R × T)

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI for 1 year = 42 ÷ 2 = ₹21

⇒ Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = 45 − 42 = ₹3

⇒ The difference is the additional interest earned on the 1st year's SI.

⇒ Rate of Interest (R) = (3 ÷ 21) × 100 = 100/7%

⇒ Principal (P) = (SI for 1 year × 100) ÷ R

⇒ P = (21 × 100) ÷ (100/7)

⇒ P = 21 × 7 = ₹147

**∴ The correct answer is ₹147.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years

For a given principal P and rate R, the difference for 2 years is calculated as: CI − SI = P(R/100)².

First Year Interest Property

For the first year, simple interest and compound interest are exactly the same when compounded annually. The difference arises in the second year due to interest calculated on the first year's interest.

Rate Determination Shortcut

When both CI and SI for 2 years are given, the rate can be directly found as: Rate = [2 × (CI − SI) ÷ SI] × 100.
